Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big dog named Max who was very lazy. Every day, Lily would run around the house and bark at Tom. Max didn't like hiding from the bed because he always brought his food.

One day, Lily decided to take Max outside to play. They walked around the yard, climbed a big fence and chased each other. Max was not so lazy, he went up the fence to a friendly place where he saw Lily. When he got out, he dropped his toys and ran back into the fence.

Lily was sad
